messages:
Sam: main CI turned red after the recent lockfile bump. failing test: transport/test_pool.py::test_connection_reuse on ubuntu-py310. anyone else seeing this?

ci-bot: Job failed: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/9801 — pytest -k test_connection_reuse — exit code 1

Jen: can you grab the traceback / pip freeze from the job? :eyes:

Sam: pasted job snippets:
```
E       AssertionError: expected 200 but got 0
E       requests.exceptions.ConnectionError: (\'Connection broken: IncompleteRead(0 bytes read)\', IncompleteRead(0 bytes))

tests/transport/test_pool.py:42: AssertionError
```

Ashok: hmm likely a transitive dependency change. what versions were installed in CI?

Sam: pip freeze from the failing job:
```
requests==2.31.0
urllib3==2.1.0
httpx==0.24.0
pytest==7.4.0
```

Leo: urllib3 2.x changed some response streaming/pooling internals. quick local check: downgrade urllib3 to 1.26.16 with the same requests version and the test passes for me.

Sam: reproduced locally: requests==2.31.0 + urllib3==2.1.0 => failure; urllib3==1.26.16 => pass. so it's definitely the urllib3 bump.

Jen: two short-term options: (A) revert the lock bump (pin urllib3<2) to get CI green, or (B) update the test/runtime to handle the new urllib3 semantics. revert sounds faster to unblock.

Ashok: agree. can someone open a revert PR that pins urllib3<2 in the lockfile and mark DNM until CI passes? I can run a bisect later for the exact regression commit.

Sam: opened draft PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4195 — draft: revert urllib3 bump & pin <2 — DNM

ci-bot: Rerun requested by Jen — queued job 9808 (revert branch)

Leo: if the revert passes, merge and then follow up with: add a test covering the pooling/stream read behavior and evaluate compatibility patch for urllib3 2.x. could be either a small compatibility shim or a change to how we close/consume responses.

Sam: filing follow-up ticket RED-2381 to track evaluating urllib3 2.x compatibility and adding regression tests.

Jen: also pinging infra to pause automated lock-regen so it doesn't flip again while we triage.

ci-bot: Job 9808 passed on ubuntu-py310 — all checks green.

Ashok: merging the revert now. i'll run a local git bisect later if we need the exact commit.

Sam: merged and added the changelog note. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
